issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing init_world(width, height) to set dimensions (problem_statement.md lines 21-22), but the template repository (template_repository/helloWorld.asm) contains no stub or reference to init_world. The provided solution (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm) does add an init_world label, but its implementation only reads a single parameter (only handles width via [esp+4]) rather than two parameters (width and height) as described. This mismatch can confuse students about whether they must implement init_world at all, what its expected parameters are, and how to access them in the template code.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the specification and templates consistent. Either remove the init_world(width, height) requirement from the problem statement if it's not part of this exercise, or (preferably) add a clear init_world stub to the template with the expected two-parameter calling convention and document how parameters are passed on the stack. Also update the solution to match the documented signature (read both width and height, e.g. [esp+4] and [esp+8]) so students have a consistent example and a working starter file.
